# Polynovea

> Polynovea is an AI and data company building the Human Behavioral Intelligence Framework (HBIF) — infrastructure that observes human decision-making, extracts repeatable patterns, and converts them into operational systems.

Polynovea is the parent company. It is not a music company, a venue company, or an event agency. Those are execution surfaces.

The actual foundation is behavioral intelligence infrastructure: a closed loop that observes how humans behave inside commercial environments, extracts the patterns, and converts them into frameworks, products, and automated systems.

Hospitality is the first deployment domain — chosen because live environments produce the fastest behavioral feedback loops of any industry. The framework itself is domain-agnostic. The long-term destination is aerospace and defense intelligence infrastructure.

**Polynovea Records** is the cultural and IP arm of the ecosystem — the Milestone 2 daughter company. It is one deployment surface of the parent behavioral intelligence system, not the parent itself. It is a music label and live experience operator that uses the HBIF as its operating layer.

## The Four Milestones

- Milestone 1 — Intelligence Infrastructure: the behavioral intelligence pipeline (Module 2: acquisition and behavioral analysis of 6,000+ venues; Module 3: live experience optimization and show engineering)
- Milestone 2 — Polynovea Records: the cultural and IP layer, artist development, live execution
- Milestone 3 — External Services: commercializing parts of the intelligence infrastructure; includes Cappella (audio analysis platform)
- Milestone 4 — Distribution, Rights & Ownership: full-stack ecosystem control

## Company Identity

- Parent company: Polynovea (AI, data, and behavioral intelligence)
- Cultural arm: Polynovea Records (music label, live experiences, IP)
- Framework: Human Behavioral Intelligence Framework (HBIF)
- Current domain: Hospitality (proving ground, domain 1 of N)
- Long-term destination: Aerospace and defense intelligence infrastructure
- Location: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Founded: 2023
- Founder: Subrojit Roy
